resources.string: Enter the address of your WordPress blog. WPoster checks it and then helps you connect securely.

WordPress will now open in your browser. Log in there as usual and confirm access for “WPoster”.\n\nWPoster then automatically receives its own application password – your normal password is never stored.
Log in in browser & allow access
After you confirm, the browser returns to WPoster automatically.
Application passwords require WordPress 5.6 or newer and HTTPS.
Enter your WordPress username and the application password you created in your profile.
Access was denied in WordPress. You can try again or create an application password yourself.
No browser found to open the page.
Share photos and videos straight from your gallery to WPoster.
Tap + to write a new post.
Open the menu ☰ for search, calendar and your blogs.
This is your only blog, so it\'s always shown on start.
The blog and its login details will be removed from this device. The application password stays valid in WordPress until you revoke it there (Users → Profile → Application Passwords).
You have several blogs connected. Choose where the shared photos and videos should go.
Your open draft for “%1$s” will be discarded.
Your open draft will be discarded.
Post photos and videos from your phone straight to your WordPress blog.
Select photos and videos, tap “Share” and choose WPoster.
Browse all posts and find them by text or by date.
Change text, photos, categories and tags on the go.
Connect as many blogs as you like and switch between them in no time.
Location data is removed from photos before uploading. No tracking.
